description:
About the job

Senior Digital Marketing Specialist

SEO | Google Ads | PPC | Social Media | US Market




We’re looking for an experienced, results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to grow our retro video gaming eCommerce business in the US market.




You should have strong hands-on expertise in SEO, Google Ads, PPC, and social media management, with the ability to turn marketing activity into qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and sales. Proven experience targeting US customers is essential.




Key Responsibilities




Develop and execute technical, on-page, and off-page SEO strategies. Optimize product pages, collections, and blog content to improve search visibility, organic traffic, and sales.




Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns. Handle keyword research, audience targeting, bidding, budgets, and ongoing testing.




Manage Microsoft Advertising campaigns, Bing Webmaster Tools, and relevant business accounts to expand visibility and customer acquisition.




Distribute and promote our video content across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Improve titles, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, and posting strategies to grow organic reach and engagement.




Maintain content calendars, publish consistently, engage with the community, and build an active audience of retro gaming enthusiasts.




Manage and optimize video and product advertising on relevant social platforms, including audience testing and retargeting.




Manage product advertising feeds and Google Merchant Center, and coordinate improvements to product pages and landing pages.




Monitor conversions, revenue, ROAS, acquisition costs, organic performance, and social engagement. Provide clear reports with practical recommendations.




Work with our designers, video editors, content team, and developers to deliver effective campaigns for US customers.




 Substantial hands-on digital marketing experience, supported by a portfolio of measurable results. Proven success managing US-focused eCommerce campaigns. Strong expertise in SEO, Google Ads, PPC, and Microsoft Advertising. Experience growing social media accounts and promoting video content organically. Confidence using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and relevant SEO tools. Ability to manage budgets, troubleshoot performance issues, and improve campaign profitability. Strong written English and an understanding of US customer behavior. An organized, proactive approach with clear ownership of results. Experience with Shopify, gaming products, retro consoles, or collectibles will be a strong advantage.

description:
About the job

Performance Marketing Lead




Apply here: https://tricurainsurance.io/careers/performance-marketing-lead




Remote (Latin America-based; English-fluent)

Department: Marketing (3 people)

Reports to: Director of Marketing

Direct reports: None — 100% hands-on

Company size: ~70 employees




About Tricura:




Tricura Insurance Group is a next-generation, tech-enabled insurance and risk management company transforming how healthcare organizations protect, manage, and grow their operations.




We're a global, remote-first team headquartered in New York, combining deep insurance expertise with modern technology to build smarter, faster, and more transparent solutions for the healthcare industry.




We're building products and internal systems that leverage AI, automation, and data to fundamentally improve how our business operates.




If you're excited by combining marketing, technology, data, and business economics to solve complex growth challenges — and want significant ownership over how a company invests in marketing — we'd love to meet you.




About the Role:




We're looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead to own the strategy, economics, and execution of our paid and data-driven marketing programs.




This is not a traditional performance marketing role where you're handed a budget and a target CAC and asked to optimize campaigns against it.




We want someone who can understand the economics of the business, determine what marketing should optimize for, form an independent point of view, and then build and execute the strategy to get there.




You'll work across paid media, programmatic marketing, ABM, marketing analytics, attribution, conversion optimization, and marketing automation.




You'll need to understand the relationship between CAC, revenue per customer, retention, margins, LTV, funnel conversion, and marketing investment — and use that understanding to make better decisions about where and how we spend.




We're also sitting on a strong source of potential demand: we often know which companies fit our ICP, who the relevant decision-makers are, that they're interested in our products, and when they're likely to make a buying decision. Your opportunity is to turn that information into sophisticated, measurable programs that influence buying behavior and improve conversion.




This is a senior, highly autonomous, hands-on individual contributor role. You won't have a team initially, but you'll be expected to bring your own ideas, challenge assumptions, and help determine how performance marketing should evolve.




What You'll Do:




Own Marketing Economics & Strategy

Analyze CAC, LTV, revenue per customer, gross margin, retention, ROAS, and funnel conversion
Determine appropriate acquisition economics and marketing investment levels
Develop channel and budget allocation strategies based on expected business impact
Build business cases for increasing, decreasing, or reallocating marketing spend
Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks

Vicepresidente Regional de Suscripción | Ficohsa Seguros




🚀 ¿Te apasiona liderar la estrategia de suscripción y reaseguro en una organización con presencia regional?




En Ficohsa Seguros, estamos buscando un(a) Vicepresidente Regional de Suscripción, un líder con visión estratégica, sólida experiencia técnica y capacidad para impulsar el crecimiento rentable del negocio a través de una gestión integral del riesgo.




📍 Ubicación: Tegucigalpa, Honduras (Presencial)




¿Cuál será tu impacto?

Serás responsable de definir y liderar la estrategia regional de suscripción para los distintos mercados donde operamos, garantizando un equilibrio sostenible entre crecimiento, rentabilidad y gestión de riesgos.




Tus principales retos incluyen:

Liderar la estrategia regional de suscripción de seguros y fianzas.
Gestionar programas de reaseguro, coaseguro y estructuras de fronting para negocios de alta complejidad.
Impulsar el desarrollo de nuevos productos y soluciones enfocadas en las necesidades del mercado, así como acompañar negociación de cuentas corporativas y estratégicas.
Fortalecer relaciones con reaseguradores, corredores y socios estratégicos internacionales.
Generar análisis ejecutivos y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones de alta dirección.




Perfil que buscamos

✔ Profesional graduado en Administración, Ingeniería, Actuaría o carreras afines.

✔ MBA o estudios de posgrado en Ciencias Actuariales (deseable).

✔ Más de 5 años de experiencia en Suscripción de Seguros de Personas o Seguros Generales o en posiciones relacionadas con Reaseguros.

✔ Experiencia liderando negociaciones complejas y relacionamiento con mercados reaseguradores.




¿Por qué Ficohsa Seguros?

Formarás parte de una organización líder en la región, con la oportunidad de influir directamente en la estrategia del negocio, fortalecer nuestras capacidades técnicas y contribuir al crecimiento sostenible de una de las aseguradoras más importantes de Centroamérica.

About the job

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Shopify Plus Developer to help build and scale modern enterprise ecommerce experiences on Shopify s native platform. This role will focus on developing high-performance storefronts, custom commerce logic, and platform integrations using Shopify s full extensibility stack, including Online Store 2.0 themes, Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, Customer Account Extensions, and custom apps.

You will work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to build scalable storefront experiences, integrate enterprise systems, and help shape technical solutions that support complex commerce ecosystems.

The ideal candidate brings deep Shopify Plus expertise, strong engineering fundamentals across Liquid, JavaScript, and TypeScript, and a passion for pushing Shopify s native platform to support enterprise-grade commerce.

Qualifications

Your skills and Experience: 


5+ years of ecommerce development experience with strong hands-on experience building solutions on Shopify Plus.
Deep expertise in Liquid, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with strong frontend engineering fundamentals.
Hands-on production experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, and Customer Account Extensions.
Strong experience with Shopify APIs including Admin API, Storefront API, GraphQL, Webhooks, and custom app development.
Working knowledge of Shopify backend concepts including metaobjects, metafields, and Markets in support of theme and extension development.
Strong understanding of ecommerce fundamentals including catalog management, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, fulfillment, and order lifecycle management.
Experience integrating Shopify with third-party systems such as ERP, OMS, PIM, payment providers, or fulfillment platforms.
Strong understanding of theme architecture, modern web performance optimization, and frontend engineering best practices.
Experience working within Agile product development environments.


Set Yourself Apart With:


Experience supporting Shopify B2B implementations including company accounts, catalogs, and payment terms.
Experience with Shopify Flow, event-driven architecture, and middleware orchestration.
Experience with platforms such as Datadog, Sentry, or similar observability and developer tooling.
Experience supporting WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility in production Shopify themes and storefronts.
Experience working on enterprise-scale commerce implementations with complex system integrations.
Experience supporting platform migrations to Shopify Plus from SFCC, Hybris, Magento, or similar.
Shopify certifications preferred.


Additional Information

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Senior Software Engineer
skills: Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems.

Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like.

About the job

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems.
Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery.
Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like.
Architect and operate multi-step agentic systems with well-defined inputs, outputs, validation checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop guardrails that run reliably at scale.
Embed AI-assisted capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows to improve build reliability, code quality feedback loops, and developer toil reduction.
Guide and advise product engineering teams on best practices for building observable, scalable systems acting as a force multiplier across the org, not just within DevX.
Partner directly with engineering teams to identify high-friction workflows, translate them into structured AI-assisted automation, and measure impact against defined success metrics.
Instrument AI-powered features with end-to-end logging, monitoring, evaluation, and their lifecycle from pilot through iteration or retirement.
Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building infrastructure or internal tooling for developer teams; fluency in Python or Go.
Firsthand experience with the tools, workflows, and pain points of software engineering teams; you've felt the friction yourself and know how to fix it.
Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic or LLM-powered systems in production, including practical familiarity with MCP patterns, tool-augmented workflows, or multi-step agent architectures.
Some experience integrating with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) and an understanding of tradeoffs around context management, latency, cost, and safety.
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms, including building custom workflows, reusable actions, or automation that operates on code or pull requests.
Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent); treat these as core to how you work, not a nice-to-have.
Ability to define meaningful metrics for AI-assisted tooling and run time-bound experiments to validate impact.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, LLMs)

 

 

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. description:
About the job




🚀 ALIADO COMERCIAL TPV | MONETIZA TU CARTERA DE CLIENTES

📍 CDMX | Modalidad flexible | 100% comisión




¿Ya tienes una cartera de clientes y quieres generar ingresos adicionales con ella?

Buscamos Aliados Comerciales que ya tengan relaciones comerciales activas con empresas, comercios, profesionistas o negocios y quieran incorporar un servicio de Terminal Punto de Venta (TPV) como complemento a los productos o servicios que actualmente comercializan.

No necesitas empezar desde cero.

Tu cartera ya existe. Tu relación con el cliente ya existe. Ahora puedes agregar una nueva solución a tu oferta y generar ingresos adicionales.

🎯 Objetivo del rol

Desarrollar oportunidades comerciales a través de tu cartera actual de clientes.

El objetivo es identificar clientes que tengan necesidades de cobro con tarjeta y presentarles la posibilidad de incorporar una TPV como una solución adicional a los servicios o productos que ya utilizan.

Tú mantienes la relación con tu cliente y generas la oportunidad.

Nosotros te respaldamos con el producto, proceso y cierre comercial.

💡 ¿Cómo funciona?

La dinámica es sencilla:

Tu cartera → Detectas la necesidad → Presentas la solución TPV → Nosotros desarrollamos la oportunidad → Se concreta el servicio → Tú generas comisión.

La TPV puede convertirse en un producto complementario dentro de la relación comercial que ya tienes con tus clientes.

Por ejemplo:

Si vendes productos médicos → puedes ofrecer TPV a consultorios y clínicas.
Si vendes tecnología → puedes complementar tu oferta con soluciones de cobro.
Si eres consultor empresarial → puedes identificar clientes que necesitan mejorar sus medios de pago.
Si comercializas insumos o equipamiento → puedes agregar una solución de cobro.
Si eres contador o asesor financiero → puedes detectar negocios con necesidades de cobranza y medios de pago.
Si trabajas con restaurantes, comercios, hoteles o servicios → puedes incorporar TPV a tu propuesta.
Si tienes una cartera B2B → puedes convertir parte de esa relación en nuevas oportunidades comerciales.

💼 Responsabilidades

Identificar dentro de tu cartera actual clientes potenciales para soluciones TPV.
Detectar negocios que cobren con tarjeta o tengan oportunidad de mejorar sus medios de pago.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, LLMs)

description:
About the job

About Rankbreeze




Rankbreeze helps short-term rental hosts and property managers win more bookings through better data, smarter listing optimization, and tools that make Airbnb performance easier to understand.




We help operators improve the parts of their listing that drive more visibility, more clicks, and more bookings — including rankings, photos, amenities, pricing, descriptions, and A/B testing.

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to help us grow Rankbreeze’s brand, reach more hosts, and turn our product insights into content, campaigns, and offers that property managers actually care about. Turn lookers into bookers.




About the Role




As a Marketing Manager, you'll own the bridge between what Rankbreeze builds and how the short-term rental market discovers, understands, and adopts it. You'll get access to Rankbreeze's product, customer results, Airbnb data, and short-term rental insights to create marketing that drives trial sign-ups, email growth, website traffic, and customer acquisition.




This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable writing copy, creating content, filming videos, analyzing funnels, improving website conversion, and testing new marketing ideas.




You'll work closely with the founder, product, customer success, and growth teams to make Rankbreeze the go-to platform for short-term rental operators who want to improve their Airbnb & vacation rental performance.




Our company is based in Canada, but we’re hiring for this role anywhere in the Americas.




What You'll Work On




Growing trial sign-ups, email subscribers, and website traffic with offers that genuinely help hosts win more bookings — across email, social, communities, and paid channels.
Shipping marketing that's actually useful — guides, data studies, lead magnets, and tools that STR managers genuinely want.
Growing the brand and customer base every month through a consistent content cadence and a continuously optimized funnel.
Owning the funnel: diagnose ad campaign performance, run landing-page experiments, and optimize each stage from first visit to trial to paying customer.
Creating content end-to-end: draft emails and social posts that help hosts book more nights, film feature showcases and videos breaking down A/B test winners from Airbnb listings.
Building leverage through affiliates, influencer partnerships, webinars, and community programs that compound reach over time.




What You'll Own & Manage




Product Marketing: Turn features, customer wins, and Airbnb data into clear messaging that helps hosts understand how Rankbreeze helps them get more visibility, more clicks, and more bookings.
Growth Channels & Campaigns: Build and manage campaigns across email, social, paid ads, affiliates, webinars, partnerships, and other channels to grow Rankbreeze's brand and customer base.
Website Conversion & Funnel Optimization: Improve website copy, landing pages, CTAs, and trial sign-up flows by analyzing performance data, identifying bottlenecks, and running tests.
Content & Demand Generation: Create useful, high-converting content such as emails, social posts, videos, blog posts, lead magnets, data studies, and product updates that attract STR hosts and drive trial sign-ups.




What Makes You a Great Fit




You may be a great fit if you:




Can explain complex product topics in simple, compelling language
Understand how to create content that drives sign-ups, not just engagement
Are comfortable being on camera or creating video content
Like testing different hooks, offers, pages, and campaigns
Care about measurable growth
Can analyze marketing performance and turn it into action
Understand the difference between activity and outcomes
Enjoy working in a fast-moving startup environment
Are excited about helping Airbnb hosts and property managers win more bookings




What Success Looks Like




Within your first few months, success would look like:




Rankbreeze is consistently reaching more short-term rental hosts every week
Trial sign-ups are growing
Website conversion rates are improving
Email list growth is accelerating
Product launches are organized, clear, and more effective
Rankbreeze has a stronger content engine across email, social, video, and website
Hosts better understand how Rankbreeze helps them improve their Airbnb listings and win more bookings




What We're Looking For




You are both strategic and hands-on. You can think through systems, but you can also write the email, film the video, improve the landing page, and analyze the results.

You have experience with:




Product/SaaS marketing
Content marketing with data
Email marketing
Paid acquisition




Experience in short-term rentals, Airbnb, real estate, hospitality, or property management is a strong bonus, but not required.




Join Rankbreeze Today




Grow with a fast-scaling SaaS company in a high-ownership role where your work actually matters 
Be part of a fully remote global team building something meaningful, shipping fast, and winning together 
You’ll get to work with booking funnel data, customer stories, product insights, and A/B test results that hosts actually care about. Your work will directly help property managers improve their listings, grow their revenue, and make better decisions.




If you’re excited about product marketing, SaaS growth, and helping Airbnb hosts win more bookings, we’d love to hear from you.




Important notes for all applicants: All remuneration is in USD, regardless of candidate location. We are unable to sponsor any visas or facilitate visa transfers. Applications and CVs must be in English to be considered. You must complete all applicant questions to be shortlisted for screening.




Rankbreeze asks respectfully to only apply through the application form and not email/apply to them directly. Recruiters and Agencies please do not contact Rankbreeze directly.

title: Senior Salesforce CRM Developer
skills: 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on development experience across Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, with expert-level proficiency in Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueables) and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Advanced knowledge of SOQL and SOSL, with a proven ability to design scalable data models (custom objects, junction objects, big objects) while optimizing queries to prevent governor limit exceptions in high-volume environments.

Extensive experience building, consuming, and securing external web services using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth2 authorization flows, and platform event integration (Pub/Sub API, MuleSoft).
Strong mastery of enterprise design patterns in Apex (Trigger Frameworks, Service Layer, Selector Layer, Domain Layer) and declarative vs. programmatic trade-off analysis.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, source-driven development (SFDX), Git workflows, unit testing enforcing >85% code coverage, and CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, or GitHub Actions).
Active Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II (PD1 / PD2) certifications are highly preferred.
Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
Experience with Salesforce CPQ, OmniStudio (Vlocity), or Experience Cloud implementations.
Certifications such as Salesforce Certified Data Architecture & Management Designer or Integration Architecture Designer.
Exposure to Data Cloud (CDP), CRM Analytics (Tableau CRM/Einstein Analytics), or AI features (Agentforce/Einstein 1).
Background in migrating legacy Visualforce pages and Aura components to modern LWC.
Design, write, and maintain high-quality Apex code, custom LWC user interfaces, and asynchronous backend processing frameworks.
Architect and build secure, bidirectional integrations between Salesforce and third-party enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, HubSpot, BigQuery) using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
Profile execution logs, optimize complex trigger handlers, and refactor inefficient legacy code to guarantee rapid page loads and bulk data processing stability.
Manage source-driven deployments using Salesforce CLI and Git-based CI/CD pipelines, ensuring safe environment sandbox management and release predictability.
Partner with Salesforce Architects, Business Analysts, and product owners to translate enterprise business needs into robust, scalable technical blueprints.

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

title: Head of Community Marketing
skills: Design and oversee the implementation of macro Community Marketing strategies for SSA, ensuring full alignment with Theogames' and clients' global goals.

Work in constant coordination with directors and leaders across relevant regional divisions (Press and Creators, Social Media, Influencer Marketing & Paid Media) to ensure strategic alignment and optimal performance in joint campaigns.
Identify and implement industry best practices and technologies, ensuring optimal quality, innovation, and results from the entire team.
Constantly evaluate, redefine, and refine engagement and growth processes and KPIs, proposing structural adjustments for approval by agency leadership.
Partner & Business Relations

Maintain frequent, periodic, high-level contact with all regional clients, ensuring the quality of community and marketing strategies is monitored and adjusted to meet their specific needs and guidelines.

Proactively identify potential business opportunities (upselling/cross-selling) and present market insights to agency leadership, providing the necessary information regarding potential expansion opportunities.
Represent Theogames and its clients at trade shows and global or regional events, strengthening the company's institutional presence and leveraging high-level networking opportunities.
Oversee the development of major strategic partnerships with local organizations, player groups, and other relevant entities to expand the agency's reach and influence within the gaming market.
Provide executive oversight for the creation and impact of engagement programs (events, feedback campaigns, social activities).
Ensure the team maintains client relevance within local audiences in an authentic manner aligned with Theogames' values, fostering an inclusive and dynamic environment.
Ensure that insights and feedback from the community are seamlessly integrated into service and product development, both internally and for clients.

Manage, evaluate, and mentor direct reports (such as the Social Media and Influencer Marketing leads), ensuring consistent strategy execution and the maintenance of high-quality standards across the vertical.
Foster a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance work environment, driving the continuous professional development of leaders and the entire team under your purview.
Extensive, proven experience in community management and community marketing, preferably with strong experience in the gaming sector.
Prior experience in area/region leadership, guiding operational leads and managing multiple teams and projects simultaneously.
Deep understanding of gaming industry culture, market dynamics, and trends across Latin America, including Brazil.
Strong business vision with the ability to identify commercial opportunities and manage direct relationships with strategic clients.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills in Spanish and English.
Comprehensive command of data-driven strategies, analytical methodologies, and advanced community management platforms.
It's a 100% remote position, under a contractor model, in which you would send us monthly invoices in your country’s currency (Ex. Argentina Peso) and paid directly to your local bank account.
15 days of paid time off per calendar year, to use in any order you prefer.

By the end of the year, the agency takes a "recess period" of around 5 days for Christmas + New Year's eve; Local holidays are also respected as paid time off. Of course, sometimes this depends on a case by case basis, since working with global brands may require acting according to their schedule, but it's something we always try to balance and compensate for, so even if something critical needs to be taken care of, you will be able to take the corresponding day off at another moment.

Annual bonus of up to 100% (100% when completing a full calendar year of work and adjusted accordingly for newer arrivals) equivalent to 1 month’s full payment, paid at the end of the year (December), when renewing contract.

销售预测及数据分析能力。

在墨西哥本地文具或快消品行业担任过部门经理或总监级别岗位的经验。
具备区域代理商/经销商体系深度运营经验。

 Drive continuous improvement through testing, learning, analytics, and innovation in promotional planning, execution, and measurement.

You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, brand fit, and adherence to the prompt; identify issues in search intent alignment, keyword strategy, on-page SEO, technical SEO logic, content structure, measurement/attribution, and compliance/claims risk; fact-check where needed; write high-quality explanations and model outputs that demonstrate best practices; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on effectiveness and reasoning quality. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your SEO and digital marketing expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by making their growth strategy, search optimization, and marketing writing more accurate, reliable, and clearly explained.

Important

There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.

Key Responsibilities


 Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts and gold-standard SEO/digital marketing outputs (content briefs, strategy notes, optimizations, analyses).
 Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to improve intent match, correctness, clarity, and practical applicability.
 Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI outputs for inaccuracies, brand-risk claims, policy/compliance pitfalls, and bias; validate reliability across use cases.

 Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

 Strong command of SEO fundamentals: keyword research, intent mapping, information architecture, internal linking, content briefs, SERP analysis.
 Working knowledge of technical SEO and site health: crawl/indexation, canonicalization, redirects, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals basics, schema.
 Strong analytics and measurement instincts: GA4, Search Console, dashboards, experiment design, attribution caveats.
 Ability to evaluate writing and strategy for clarity, structure, persuasion, and brand voice, including landing pages and SEO blog content.
 Exceptional attention to detail when spotting weak logic, overclaims, hallucinated facts, or risky marketing claims; minimum C1 English proficiency.
 Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor workflow across time zones.
 Previous experience with AI data training/annotation, editorial QA, content ops, or performance marketing review is strongly preferred.



Desired Skills and Experience

Content Optimization, Link Building/Digital PR, Keyword Research, Technical SEO, SEO Strategy, English, Analytics (GA4), On-Page SEO, Search Intent, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

This role requires the candidate to work on-site in Ciudad de México (CDMX), Mexico.

Our client is a confidential, licensed financial technology company operating a rapidly growing digital lending platform in Mexico. Backed by an international technology group with deep expertise in artificial intelligence, big data, and digital financial services, the company provides innovative consumer finance solutions that promote financial inclusion through technology-driven lending products.

Operating in one of Latin America's fastest-growing fintech markets, the organization combines advanced digital platforms, data-driven decision-making, and robust risk management to strengthen its market position while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

As part of its continued expansion, the company is seeking an experienced executive to lead its marketing organization in Mexico, driving brand growth, customer acquisition, and commercial performance. Please note that this is a confidential executive search. The company name and additional details will only be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the interview process.

The Director of Marketing will lead the overall marketing strategy, brand development, customer acquisition, and commercial growth initiatives for the Mexico market. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, this executive role is responsible for aligning local marketing strategies with global business objectives while overseeing integrated campaigns, marketing operations, agency partnerships, and organizational leadership.

description:
About the job

Web Developer IEWD035 E-commerce, Funnels & Checkout Infrastructure

Build fast. Protect what’s live. Own the technical quality behind every conversion.




Job Snapshot

Position: Web Developer

Focus: E-commerce, Funnels & Checkout Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Compensation: $1,500–$3,000 USD/month

Employment: Full-time/contractor

Industry: Pet Wellness / DTC E-commerce

We’re looking for a Web Developer who can turn briefs, designs, and campaign requirements into polished, responsive, conversion-ready experiences while owning the technical infrastructure behind our pages, funnels, checkout, and subscription systems.

Success isn’t simply “the page is built.” It means the page ships on time, looks right, works across devices, tracks correctly, and is ready for paid traffic without surprises.




About the Company

We’re a fast-moving, performance-driven Pet Wellness DTC e-commerce business where web development directly impacts revenue.

Our website infrastructure supports paid advertising, product launches, CRO tests, checkout flows, and subscription customers. A broken checkout can cost revenue. A delayed landing page can hold up a campaign. Poorly implemented tests can produce unreliable data. Slow or broken mobile experiences can waste paid traffic.

We need someone who understands that responsibility and takes ownership of the finished result.




The Role

You’ll own the technical implementation and ongoing quality of our web and checkout ecosystem, including:

Sales and landing pages
Product pages
Custom checkout experiences
Funnel architecture and page connections
Subscription experiences
CRO test implementation
Mobile responsiveness and page performance
Integrations, tracking, QA, maintenance, and bug fixing

You’ll work across Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Gempages, and Funnelish, treating them as one connected revenue system.

Marketing owns the strategy and copy. The CRO/Media Buying team owns test hypotheses and performance analysis.




You own making sure the technical execution works.




Responsibilities

1. Build & Launch Pages on Time

Build sales pages, landing pages, and product pages from approved briefs, designs, copy, and campaign direction.

You’ll be responsible for delivering pages that are:

Responsive
Visually polished
Brand-aligned
Conversion-focused
Technically reliable
Ready for paid traffic

You should be able to estimate work realistically, communicate timelines, and flag blockers before they become missed deadlines.




2. Own Checkout & Funnel Reliability

Build and maintain custom checkout experiences and the technical connections between pages.

You’ll ensure:

Redirects work correctly
Payment flows function properly
Tracking fires accurately
Subscription flows work end-to-end
Integrations remain connected
Funnel logic functions as intended
Customers can move smoothly from first click through conversion




3. Maintain the E-commerce Stack

Own the day-to-day technical implementation across:

Shopify
CheckoutChamp
Gempages
Funnelish

Maintain configurations and integrations while proactively identifying technical risks before they become revenue problems.




4. Implement CRO Tests

Turn approved CRO hypotheses into clean, measurable test implementations.

You’ll ensure variants are built accurately, tracking is reliable, and active experiments aren't compromised by undocumented or unauthorized changes.




5. QA & Protect Live Infrastructure

Your responsibility doesn’t end when a page goes live.




You’ll:

QA across devices and browsers
Check mobile responsiveness
Monitor page performance
Troubleshoot bugs
Maintain existing infrastructure
Validate tracking and integrations
Fix post-launch issues
Protect active tests and live revenue pages

When you say a page is ready for traffic, the team should trust that it is ready.

What Success Looks Like

You’re succeeding when:

Projects consistently launch on schedule
Pages are polished and responsive before launch
Checkout and funnel flows work reliably end-to-end
Mobile performance is strong
CRO tests are implemented accurately
Tracking and integrations work as expected
Post-launch bugs are minimized through strong QA
Technical and deadline risks are surfaced early
Stakeholders know project status without chasing you
Live pages and active experiments are handled carefully

The standard is simple:

When you say something is ready for traffic, it should actually be ready for traffic.




Required Experience

This role is best suited to a mid-to-senior Web Developer who can execute independently within an established e-commerce environment.




You should have:

Strong experience building responsive, conversion-focused web pages
Hands-on e-commerce and/or direct-response funnel development experience
Experience building and customizing product and checkout experiences
Strong understanding of mobile responsiveness and cross-browser QA
Experience with integrations, tracking, redirects, and funnel logic
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
High attention to visual detail and brand consistency
Ability to estimate work and consistently meet deadlines
Strong written communication in a remote environment
Good judgment around live-system changes and technical risk

Strong preference for candidates with experience in Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Gempages, Funnelish, or comparable e-commerce/funnel platforms.




Tools & Environment




Our core stack includes:

Shopify
CheckoutChamp
Gempages
Funnelish
Tracking and conversion integrations
Subscription and payment infrastructure
CRO testing tools and workflows
Project and communication systems

You don’t need years of experience with every platform.

You do need the technical ability to understand how the systems connect and take ownership of the ecosystem as a whole.




Compensation

$1,500–$3,0000 USD/month

Final compensation depends on experience, technical ability, platform familiarity, and demonstrated ownership.

This is an opportunity to own web infrastructure that directly affects revenue rather than simply completing disconnected development tickets.




Hiring Process

Application → Initial Interview → Practical/Test Task → Final Interview → Offer




We care less about buzzwords and more about how you:

Think through technical problems
Build
QA
Troubleshoot
Communicate
Manage deadlines
Take ownership




Who Thrives Here

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

Take deadlines seriously
Have a high standard for what you ship
Notice visual and technical problems before someone points them out
Think beyond “it works on my computer”
Communicate blockers early
Enjoy figuring out how platforms and integrations connect
Can work with Marketing, Media Buying/CRO, and Operations
Treat live pages, active experiments, checkout infrastructure, and tracking carefully
Follow projects through after launch
Prefer ownership and autonomy over constant supervision




Who Will Struggle

This role probably isn’t right for you if you:

Regularly need reminders to meet deadlines
Go quiet when a project falls behind
Need detailed instructions for every implementation decision
Consider QA someone else’s responsibility
Make casual changes to live pages or active tests
Build technically functional pages without caring how they look
Prefer narrow ticket execution over ownership
Struggle to communicate technical risks early




We want someone we can trust with infrastructure that generates revenue.




Application

If you’re a Web Developer who wants to own more than code and can take responsibility for the quality, reliability, and on-time delivery of the pages behind a growing e-commerce business, we want to hear from you.




Apply here:

https://www.orgboard.co/jobs/0cb846c3b6a841deaf97616c72d96995?src=linkedin_recruiter

Please include examples of pages, funnels, e-commerce experiences, or checkout flows you’ve built. Where possible, explain what you personally owned on each project.




We’re not hiring someone just to build pages.

We’re hiring someone we can trust when those pages go live.

Due to the volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

description:
About the job

The Global Transportation Pricing & Benchmarking Manager is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for analyzing transportation data to identify pricing, benchmarking, sourcing, and measurable savings opportunities across multiple transportation modes. The role combines advanced transportation pricing analysis with customer-facing solution development and transportation provider negotiations.




This individual owns pricing and benchmarking engagements from analysis through recommendation and commercial execution: understanding current transportation costs, normalizing complex rate structures, establishing meaningful benchmarks, developing sourcing and negotiation strategies, presenting and defending recommendations, and participating in or leading transportation provider negotiations designed to convert identified opportunities into measurable customer results.




The position does not initially require direct personnel management. The Manager title reflects ownership of the pricing and benchmarking function and accountability for customer outcomes.

The position requires broad transportation knowledge, with particular emphasis on domestic and international small parcel, international heavy air freight, and international ocean freight.

Experience with LTL, Truckload, Rail, Intermodal, Drayage, and other transportation modes is also valuable. Candidates do not need to be equally experienced in every mode; demonstrated depth in one or more priority modes and the ability to expand across modes will be considered.




Key Responsibilities include




Transportation Pricing & Benchmarking

Analyze shipment-level, invoice, rate, surcharge, accessorial, service-level, lane, zone, weight, and transportation provider data to establish a complete current-state transportation cost profile.
Validate benchmarking and savings models against actual freight invoice and shipment-level spend so recommendations reflect the true cost of transportation, including base transportation charges, fuel, accessorials, minimums, dimensional weight, duties and taxes where applicable, and other contractual charges.
Develop and maintain transportation pricing benchmarks by mode, lane, geography, service level, weight break, zone, shipment characteristic, and other relevant cost drivers.
Benchmark customer pricing against internal transportation data, historical sourcing events and bids, transportation provider proposals, customer-specific agreements, and appropriate external market intelligence.
Normalize pricing to create meaningful like-for-like comparisons, including base rates, discounts, minimums, fuel, accessorials, dimensional weight, zones, weight breaks, origin/destination charges, and contractual terms.
Develop current-state versus proposed-state cost models and quantify realistic savings opportunities.
Identify pricing trends, anomalies, unfavorable contract provisions, cost drivers, and opportunities for improved transportation pricing or service alignment.
Help develop and maintain reusable nVision Global benchmarking methodologies, databases, tools, and market intelligence capabilities.

 

Small Parcel Pricing

 Analyze domestic and international parcel pricing structures, including zones, service levels, weight breaks, dimensional weight, minimum charges, fuel, residential and delivery-area surcharges, additional handling, oversize charges, international surcharges, and earned/tiered discounts.
Evaluate customer-specific parcel agreements and model alternative pricing structures, provider scenarios, service changes, and negotiation opportunities.
International Heavy Air & Ocean Pricing
Analyze international heavy air pricing including chargeable weight, actual versus dimensional weight, lane pricing, origin/destination charges, fuel/security charges, forwarder pricing, consolidation, and airport-to-airport versus door-to-door structures.
Analyze ocean pricing including FCL/LCL, container types, port pairs, origin/destination charges, drayage, fuel-related charges, detention/demurrage concepts, accessorials, and forwarder/NVOCC pricing structures.

 

Sourcing, Negotiation & Commercial Execution

Develop sourcing strategies, bid packages, pricing scenarios, negotiation targets, and evaluation models for transportation RFPs/RFQs.
Evaluate transportation provider bids and proposals, normalize responses, identify material differences, and determine whether proposed pricing is competitive and commercially sound.
Participate in and, when appropriate, lead transportation provider pricing and contract negotiations.
Translate benchmark findings into specific negotiation positions and defend those positions using data and financial analysis.
Measure negotiated results against baseline and modeled expectations to confirm realized savings and identify follow-up opportunities.




Customer & Sales Support

Translate complex transportation pricing and benchmarking analysis into clear business recommendations for customers and prospects.
Present and defend findings with customer executives, procurement teams, transportation professionals, finance teams, and other stakeholders.
Support nVision Global Sales and Supply Chain Services teams during discovery, solution development, customer presentations, RFPs, sourcing initiatives, and negotiations.
Clearly explain the methodology, assumptions, data, risks, and financial impact supporting each recommendation.
Help convert analytical findings into compelling, credible business cases that demonstrate measurable customer value.




Data Analysis & Reporting

Analyze customer and nVision Global data across orders, shipments, freight invoices, transportation rates, and related supply chain information.
Use advanced Excel, nSight, IMPACT AdHoc Reporting, BI tools, and other analytical technologies to develop models, dashboards, and management-ready reporting.
Maintain high standards for data accuracy, consistency, documentation, assumptions, and analytical methodology.
Work with Operations, Freight Audit & Payment, Supply Chain Services, Sales, IT, and Finance to ensure analyses reflect operational and financial realities.




Qualifications include

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in transportation pricing, rate analysis, benchmarking, procurement, sourcing, freight audit, transportation analytics, or related disciplines. Demonstrated capability is more important than years of experience.

Freight Audit & Invoice Analysis: Experience reviewing and interpreting freight invoices and understanding the relationship between contracted transportation rates, shipment characteristics, invoice charges, and actual transportation spend is strongly preferred. Candidates with freight audit experience should be able to recognize billing discrepancies, rate application issues, accessorial charges, and other cost drivers that may affect benchmarking, sourcing, and negotiation strategies.

Transportation Expertise: Demonstrated experience in Domestic and/or International Small Parcel, International Heavy Air, or International Ocean transportation. Experience across multiple priority modes is strongly preferred.

Analytical Capability: Demonstrated ability to interpret complex transportation rate agreements, analyze shipment-level data, normalize transportation costs, develop financial models, identify savings opportunities, and support recommendations with defensible data.

Customer-Facing / Commercial Capability: Ability to translate complex transportation pricing analysis into clear business recommendations and confidently present and defend findings. More experienced candidates must demonstrate customer-facing consultative experience and the ability to participate in or lead transportation provider pricing negotiations. Experience supporting Sales, customer presentations, sourcing events, and negotiations is strongly preferred.

Technology: Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, scenario modeling, and financial analysis. Experience with BI/reporting tools and large transportation datasets is strongly preferred.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex transportation pricing concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.




Candidate Profile

nVision Global is seeking an analytically strong transportation professional who is commercially capable, intellectually curious, and comfortable moving between detailed shipment-level data and executive-level recommendations. The successful candidate must be willing to challenge assumptions, support conclusions with data, and take ownership of recommendations rather than simply produce analysis.

A candidate earlier in their career may succeed in this position if they demonstrate strong transportation pricing knowledge, analytical ability, communication skills, and the potential to grow into customer-facing negotiation responsibilities. A more senior candidate will be expected to bring immediate customer-facing credibility, consultative presentation skills, and the ability to independently support or lead transportation provider negotiations.




Success will be measured by the ability to:

Produce accurate, defensible transportation pricing and benchmarking analyses that identify measurable opportunities.
Build increasingly robust nVision Global benchmarking intelligence and reusable analytical methodologies.
Translate analysis into practical sourcing, pricing, and negotiation strategies.
Present findings clearly and credibly to internal teams, customers, prospects, and transportation providers.

description:
About the job

Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations.

As part of our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP), you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will gain leading edge operations and consulting skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a junior practice specialist on multiple client engagements and work with several colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. You will acquire the necessary knowledge and expertise to help companies achieve excellence in their operations.

Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. You will follow a curriculum based on operations excellence themes and will receive advanced training in specific areas of operations.

Additionally, you will engage with our clients to create new strategies across a wide range of projects, from automation to mine optimization to predictive maintenance and more. You will not only expand our current analytics capabilities but will help architect new strategies and applications within a dynamic innovative organization.

Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm, from associate to partner.
